# MooreRevenue

> MooreRevenue is an AI automation agency building custom AI voice agents, WhatsApp business automations, and high-performance websites for businesses worldwide.

## About

MooreRevenue was founded by Krishna Aggarwal. The agency specializes in automating customer communications, inbound call handling, lead follow-up, and internal business workflows using conversational AI voice agents, n8n, and the WhatsApp Cloud API. MooreRevenue works with businesses and enterprises across the globe.

## Services

- [AI Voice Calling & Reception Agents](https://www.moorerevenue.com/services/ai-voice-agent-faridabad): Bilingual conversational AI voice agents for 24/7 inbound customer support, outbound lead qualification, and automated appointment scheduling.
- [AI Workflow Automation](https://www.moorerevenue.com/services/ai-automation-agency-faridabad): End-to-end business workflow automation, n8n orchestrations, CRM integrations, and webhook data pipelines.
- [WhatsApp Business Automation](https://www.moorerevenue.com/services/whatsapp-automation-faridabad): Official WhatsApp Cloud API chatbots, automated product catalog inquiries, instant customer messaging, and lead routing.
- [Website Design and Development](https://www.moorerevenue.com/services/website-development-faridabad): Ultra-fast modern websites and web applications built with Astro, React, and Tailwind CSS, engineered for high conversions and top performance.
- [Local SEO and AI Search Visibility](https://www.moorerevenue.com/services/local-seo-aeo-faridabad): Business profile optimization, citation management, structured data schemas, and AI search visibility (AEO).

## Agent Tools Available

- `search_site`: Search this site by keyword and return matching pages with title, URL, and excerpt.
- `book_consultation`: Prepare a free AI discovery audit and consultation booking for MooreRevenue with direct WhatsApp contact details.
- `search_site_form`: Declarative search form allowing automated agents or browser users to query the site for matching pages.
